_comment: Alias -> release package name for VOICE_RELEASE_BASE_URL/<package>.tar.gz downloads. Package names match the directories under releases/multivoice-20260713 in the saanoTTS research repo, which is what tools/export_roota_self_contained_package.py produces per voice.
_comment_nano: Voices with "runtime": "nano" come from the voices-v2 release and run through sanotts.nano, not sanotts.models: a different graph (mel-100 -> ConvNeXt1D -> iSTFT, noise-fed decoder) that models.py rejects. Their packages carry front_q8.bin/model_q8.bin/meta.json rather than the roota.raw-fp16.v1 manifest.
